note: Run on a SCRATCH branch off local-dev only (it writes). Server: ANALYSIS_TAB_ENABLED, TUNING_ENABLED, SUGGESTED_CHANGES_V2_ENABLED, HELP_ME_CHOOSE_ENABLED, OVERVIEW_V2_ENABLED on; SOCIAL_FRIENDS_ENABLED and ANNOUNCEMENTS_ENABLED off, so no default-on kind is available; a dummy ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (stub model). Before the run the audit account must have never chosen (user_prefs feed_kinds {}, feed_kinds_declined {}, feed_offer_closed_at null). whats-new-off presses the offer's ✕, which saves the empty choice, so reset feed_offer_closed_at to null after the phone pass or the desktop offer row finds no offer. CRITICAL_DECK holds a contract-13 deck_synopses row (status done, fresh fingerprint) whose weaknesses are Critical/Moderate/Minor; DESCRIBE_DECK has no stored reading, so its Analysis tab draws the description field; the field refuses typing past 240 and decks_intent_length_check refuses storing it, so the over-cap state needs that check dropped on the scratch branch and a 241+ intent written (re-add it after). help-locked presses Find commanders under a hold, spending one stub credit.
